name: Furry Bara Magical Academy
source:
You've been transported to another world! A world of magic and monsters... but most importantly, sexy, furry men! Enrol into Xyerlinn Academy, the most prestigious magical academy on the continent, and meet your potential love interest(s).

[From [url=https://orangelo.itch.io/furry-bara-magical-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
